title: Crousbblemon
description: A modpack made to provide a great Cobblemon survival experience with trainers, gyms, raids, megas, TMs, (almost) all missing Pokémon and more !
body:
A modpack originally made to play Cobblemon with my friends but anyone can experience it as they'd like of course !

- Adds (almost) all missing Pokémon and their megas thanks to AllTheMons x MegaShowdown !
- Challenging battles through trainer, roguelike gyms and raid dens !
- Multiplayer friendly.
- Optimized for fabric.
